environment_caveats: Lighthouse ran DESKTOP only (cpuSlowdownMultiplier=1, throughputKbps=10240). Mobile scores typically run 10-20 performance points lower. Do not read these as mobile-first scores.

Client record status is "onboarding", not "active". build_status is pushed_main and apex cutover completed 2026-08-13, so the apex site was audited as live. Status mismatch still unreconciled since the 2026-08-26 audit.
Apex origin: curl -sI returned no x-robots-tag: noindex, so the staging SEO-exclusion correction does not apply. SEO counted toward the verdict.

DataForSEO on_page reports has_micromarkup=false; the check does not detect JSON-LD. Direct inspection found 3 valid JSON-LD blocks on the homepage (Organization, WebSite, LocalBusiness with AggregateRating). Not reported as a finding.

broken_image_404, og_image_404 and meta_description_too_long are source="manual_verification" (curl-confirmed). Neither vendor flagged them: Lighthouse recorded the hero.webp request with status -1 and no console error, and DataForSEO instant_pages returned broken_resources=false. They are deliberately not presented as vendor audit IDs.

Per-URL lighthouse_issues now lists every failing audit (7-8 per URL) instead of the top 5, so month-over-month new/resolved diffs are not polluted by truncation. Audits the prior run recorded on all 6 URLs at site level are not counted as new.
